name: AFortAIPawn::PickHitReactDirection
signature: FName PickHitReactDirection(const FVector& HitDirection, FName Forward, FName Back, FName Left, FName Right)
notes: Computes yaw (degrees) from this actor basis and the hit direction via 0x142c521d0; |yaw| <= 45 -> Forward; 45..120 -> Right if yaw > 0 else Left; otherwise Back.
